notes: 2 sheets (View 1 and View 2 of the same model), both checked; decimal-inch values, no unit statement. Notes: each sheet has a black 'Notes' block (text) - recorded as one note per sentence block. Captions 'Test Model 5', 'PMI Complex Test Case 5 - View n (of 2)', 'Includes Atomic Test Cases - ...' are not notes. GD&T not complete because of datum TARGETS: C1 (sheet 1) and D1 (sheet 2) target symbols with hatched target areas are not recorded as gdt.datum; datum C and D are established by those targets. Datum feature symbol A appears on both sheets (recorded twice); B on sheet 2. '5.000 ±.008' carries the statistical-tolerance symbol (ST in a hexagon) - recorded as a plain ± dimension. Boxed (basic) 2.000 and 1.250 locate the datum target on each sheet. Runout frames: single arrow = circular run-out (.025 A-B, .035 A-B, .025 A-B), double arrow = total run-out (.015 B, .002 A). Concentricity Ø.030 A. Ø10.000 ±.001 is the size of datum feature B. tolerance.tightest = Ø10.000 ±.001 (band .002). Naming rule used for Ø callouts: a callout with an 'nX' count, THRU / depth, or an uppercase (hole) fit is recorded as hole.diameter {diameter, count, upper, lower}; any other Ø size is a dimension {type:'diameter'}. Tolerances are recorded as signed deviations upper/lower; limit dimensions as max/min. GD&T: characteristic in words, datums = the datum letters in order (datum-reference modifiers not encoded), modifiers 'MMC' / 'LMC' = circled M / L after the tolerance value, diameterZone true only where Ø precedes the tolerance.
